title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Intraday Agent manages queues and schedule adherence
summary: The briefing passes: its planned autonomous actions and release targets match the roadmap, and the existing workforce-alert setting matches Microsoft Learn. Searches confirmed the narrowly stated gaps in Intraday Agent documentation. Two checklist items refer to existing workforce-management controls or reports without corresponding table rows.
